objective: Measure source sky-cove extents with sensitivity and visual checks before more shape tuning.
hypothesis: Local sky-connected source measurements constrain cove/support proportions more reliably than qualitative root-width edits.
baseline: P095 qualitative root widening failed; exact cove/support proportions unresolved.
otherGoalProtection: Read-only source analysis, no generated masks as artwork, no pin changes; report inconclusive if segmentation uncertain.

result.summary: Read-only chroma/sensitivity analysis yields independently supported lower B/C notch location band x2140–2144,y1098–1099. Upper A/J extremum shifts up to88px across thresholds, so overall measurements are inconclusive and no upper/lower proportion ratio is accepted. No source or art mutation.
result.nextAction: Stop threshold tuning. Preserve only lower-notch band; upper cove remains unknown. Any subsequent local test must isolate supported evidence and avoid whole-proportion claims.

findings: Sensitivity testing prevented a false precise uppercove claim; stable witness classifications alone do not validate a boundary.
Lower location visually verified, but stable extrema do not yield curvature law or bridge width. Do not import mask contours as artwork.
Source grain and fading make uppercove segmentation threshold-biased. Stop this method rather than expanding morphology/tests to force agreement.

actions.summary: Keep limited lower-notch location with method/landmark uncertainty.
Reject uppercove ratio and further threshold tuning; defer unsupported full-proportion changes.

review.nextImprovement: Choose only a source-supported local feature for any next experiment, or preserve checkpoint if no discriminating test fits remaining allowance.
